name: Host-Timeframe Close Confirmation v2

host_timeframe.alignment: exact UTC open timestamp on both symbols

source_admission.fresh_attach_policy: baseline existing states without retroactive candidates
source_admission.candidate_trigger: transition from non-one-sided to A_ONLY or B_ONLY
source_admission.restart_policy: restore pending candidates and finalized observation IDs from Common Files checkpoint

invariants: Only a host-bar close can finalize a candidate.
The first live one-sided transition selects exactly one target host close.
A candidate is evaluated only with source state whose availability time is not after the target close.
Source state must be available through the target close to confirm.
BOTH at close invalidates the candidate.
A_ONLY or B_ONLY at close confirms only when the role equals the initial role.
Fresh attach does not retroactively confirm a pre-existing one-sided state.
A missed host close is fail-closed and requires replay.
A finalized observation ID cannot create a second result.
Confirmed results are immutable and are not retracted by later P05 changes.
Multiple relationships and HIGH/LOW sides finalize independently in the same host candle.
P06 exports host-bar geometry for the hunter symbol only.
